newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to host Asian G6 meeting on March 4 -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to host Asian G6 meeting on March 4 -- MOF.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday that Japan would host a meeting of senior financial officials of five Asia Pacific countries and the United States on March 4.
The five Asia Pacific countries are Japan, Hong Kong, China, Australia and Singapore.
Mitsuzuka said the major issues that would be discussed would be macro-economic and financial market stability, including currencies.
"I hope this will contribute effectively to stabilising the markets," he said.
He added that he hoped the meeting would be held on a regular basis and that in future it be upgraded to include finance ministers and central bankers.
